note: Character LoRA still: UNETLoader(1) feeds LoraLoaderModelOnly(13), and KSampler(7) samples the patched model. 'lora' is the trained .safetensors name already installed in the server's loras directory (CCL3b writes character_lora.safetensors) and 'lora_strength' is its model weight. LoadImage(10) is the character's Klein reference and ReferenceMultiLatent(12) holds the reference budget, so a trained LoRA still keeps the same reference anchor as flux3_klein_ref_edit. 'image' and 'reference' are two names for that one portrait and both land on node 10; a job sets one of them. The graph wires image0 only. No URLs, credentials or local paths: model installation is a separate bootstrap/model-lock concern.
